name: qimao-terms-cloud
description: 审改工作台云端版模块化单体

scripts.dev: pnpm run db:setup && pnpm --parallel --filter @qimao-terms-cloud/backend --filter @qimao-terms-cloud/frontend run dev
scripts.db:setup: node tools/local-postgres.mjs setup && pnpm --filter @qimao-terms-cloud/backend run db:migrate
scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive --if-present run lint && node --check tools/verify-repository.mjs && node --check tools/local-postgres.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run check:repo && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
